value-xl.purpose: The one value of a tile. Figures face at font-stretch 87.5%.

value-l.purpose: The one value of a result row or strip.

figures.purpose: Numbers in columns and cells, tabular, right-aligned.

machine.purpose: Paths, raw bind tokens, journal event names and logs only.

motion.name: instant
motion.purpose: State changes are instant; nothing animates.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one orange fill per view, for the step that moves the commander forward.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--accent, #fa6e00); color: var(--on-accent, #0c0d0f); font: 600 13px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #fa6e00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--cell-opt, #2b2d2e); color: var(--text-dim, #5f6266); cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button (text action)
components.description: An orange caps verb with no fill: CHANGE, ADD STOP, RUN AGAIN.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 8px; color: var(--accent, #fa6e00); font: 600 13px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #fa6e00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-text:disabled { color: var(--text-dim, #5f6266); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Option cell: a filled cell means editable. No underline; focus is a 1 px orange outline.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; height: 34px; width: 320px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--cell-opt, #2b2d2e); color: var(--text, #e8e8e8); font: 400 15px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-lo, #a0a0a0); } .ds-input:hover { background: var(--cell-hover, #35383a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #fa6e00); }

components.name: Dropdown
components.description: Option cell with a grey chevron; the value is never orange.
components.html: <button class="ds-dropdown">Here: Sol<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><path d="M4 6l4 4 4-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-dropdown { all: unset; cursor: pointer; box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-width: 160px; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--cell-opt, #2b2d2e); color: var(--text, #e8e8e8); font: 400 15px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; } .ds-dropdown svg { color: var(--text-lo, #a0a0a0); } .ds-dropdown:hover { background: var(--cell-hover, #35383a); } .ds-dropdown:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #fa6e00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice
components.description: Segmented or filter options in cells; the chosen one is lit, never orange.
components.css: .ds-choices { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-choice { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--cell-opt, #2b2d2e); color: var(--text-lo, #a0a0a0); font: 400 13px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; } .ds-choice:hover { background: var(--cell-hover, #35383a); } .ds-choice.on { background: var(--cell-on, #45484b); color: var(--text-hi, #ffffff); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #fa6e00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Page Tabs
components.description: Mixed case; active is lit with a 2 px orange underline. Top tabs are caps with the active one orange. Two tab rows at most.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; height: 44px; font: 500 15px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs span { display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--text-lo, #a0a0a0); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs span:hover { color: var(--text, #e8e8e8); } .ds-tabs span.on { color: var(--text-hi, #ffffff); border-bottom-color: var(--accent, #fa6e00); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Outlined, never filled, mixed case, for a fact with no column of its own.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #26282b); color: var(--text-lo, #a0a0a0); font: 400 13px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; }

components.name: Material Tile
components.description: Hull surface, one big count; dimmed when none, solid orange when selected (one per view).
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tile { display: grid; width: 200px; height: 76px; padding: 10px 12px; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--surface, #131417); } .ds-tile b { font: 500 28px/1 'Saira Variable', 'Saira Semi Condensed', sans-serif; font-stretch: 87.5%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-hi, #ffffff); } .ds-tile span { align-self: end; font: 400 13px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #e8e8e8); } .ds-tile.none { background: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); outline: 1px solid var(--line, #26282b); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-tile.none b, .ds-tile.none span { color: var(--text-dim, #5f6266); } .ds-tile.sel { background: var(--accent, #fa6e00); } .ds-tile.sel b, .ds-tile.sel span { color: var(--on-accent, #0c0d0f); }

components.name: Lookup Result Row
components.description: Main value first and largest, then the place, aligned fact columns, and row actions that turn orange only on hover.

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px 1fr 80px 40px auto auto; align-items: center; column-gap: 12px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 15px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #e8e8e8); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--row-hover, #16171a); } .ds-row small { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-lo, #a0a0a0); margin-left: 3px; } .ds-row .v { text-align: right; font: 600 18px 'Saira Variable', 'Saira Semi Condensed', sans-serif; font-stretch: 87.5%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-hi, #ffffff); } .ds-row .p { font-weight: 500; } .ds-row .f { text-align: right; font-family: 'Saira Variable', 'Saira Semi Condensed', sans-serif; font-stretch: 87.5%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row .a { font: 600 13px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--text-lo, #a0a0a0); padding: 0 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover .a { color: var(--accent, #fa6e00); }

components.name: Route Strip
components.description: 36 px hull band on every page: next system and copy, n of N, flags, destination.

components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 36px; padding: 0 40px; background: var(--surface, #131417); font: 400 13px 'Saira Semi Condensed', Bahnschrift, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #e8e8e8); } .ds-strip b { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-hi, #ffffff); } .ds-strip small { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-lo, #a0a0a0); } .ds-strip .bang { color: var(--accent, #fa6e00); font-weight: 600; margin-right: -8px; } .ds-strip i { flex: 1; }

narrative.overview:
The window reads like one of Elite's own station screens: the Encoded Material Trader, the
Controls list, the station services board. Those screens are dark, nearly silent, and lit
only where something matters. Each tile has one big value. Names are smaller, ratios are a
corner mark. State is shown by brightness, not words: a dimmed tile is unavailable, the one
solid orange tile is selected. Layout carries meaning: on the trader, rows are categories and
columns are grades, so nothing needs a label to be understood. Orange means something because
almost nothing is orange.

astromech follows that thinking, not its density. The trader screen is too sparse for a
lookup window. The goal is **hierarchy, not density**: every element has one value that
outranks everything around it, and everything else steps down in size and brightness. A
commander glancing over between jumps should find the answer in under two seconds and never
have to read a caps label to find it.

The register is still the game's **Controls dialect**: near-black, one stock orange, light
grey text, filled value cells, very few lines, square corners, no ornament. What is new is
that the dialect now has rules a page can be reviewed against. The test for any screen is
not "does it look like Elite" but "can a commander find the main value, the thing they can
change, and the one thing that needs them, without reading".
keyCharacteristics: One main value per element: the largest and brightest text in its tile, row or strip.
State by brightness: lit, normal, secondary, dim. Words only when brightness is not enough.
One orange per meaning: selected, action, warning, focus. Never decoration.
A filled cell means you can change it. Read-only things never sit in a cell.
Caps for navigation and verbs only. Content is mixed case.
Numbers in tabular figures, right-aligned, in columns that line up.
Square, flat, silent: no radius, no shadow, no gradient, no glow, no motion.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange is never used for headings, section titles, values, numbers, units, prices, dropdown or input text, badges, chips, icons at rest, card borders, row separators or decoration. If it is orange, it is selected, pressable, urgent or focused.

rules.name: The One Fill Rule
rules.body: A view shows at most one solid orange fill. When a primary button and a selected tile would both be filled, the tile uses the 1 px outline instead.

rules.name: The Brightness Ladder Rule
rules.body: Inside one element, each step down in importance is a step down the ladder. Two adjacent pieces of text at the same level must differ in size or weight, or one of them should go.

rules.name: The Caps Are Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Uppercase with 0.06em tracking is allowed for exactly four roles: the wordmark, top tabs, section headings, and action words (buttons and text actions). Everything else is mixed or sentence case: page tabs, column heads, field labels, row labels, names, badges, status, empty states, errors, prose. Tracking never appears without caps, and caps never appear without tracking.

rules.name: The One Caps Line Rule
rules.body: An element (a card, a row, a tile) carries at most one caps line, and it is an action. Status and categories are not caps.

rules.name: The Machine Text Rule
rules.body: Share Tech Mono is allowed only for text a commander might compare character by character or type somewhere else: file and folder paths, raw bind tokens, journal event names, log lines, version hashes. Never for names, dates, prices, distances, counts or prose; those are Saira figures.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that sits in a column, a tile, a cell or a strip uses the figures face with tabular figures and is right-aligned in its column, so the ones digit sits under the ones digit.

rules.name: The Two Tab Rows Rule
rules.body: Navigation is at most two rows deep: top tabs and one row of page tabs. A third level becomes a choice cell inside the page (Raw / Manufactured / Encoded), a section heading, or a finder of its own. Never stack tab rows, never add a band between them.

rules.name: The Aligned Columns Rule
rules.body: Facts that repeat down a list are columns with fixed widths and a header row. If a fact would wrap, the column is too narrow or the fact should go.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts light. Selection is an outline or a fill, never a halo.

dos: Do name each element's one main value before styling it, and give it Value L or XL in Lit.
Do show availability by brightness: Dim for none, unavailable, stale or disabled.
Do keep orange to selected, action, needs-you and focus, and keep to one solid orange fill per view.
Do put every editable value in an option cell and every read-only fact outside one.
Do use mixed case for content and keep caps to the wordmark, top tabs, section heads and action words.
Do set numbers in the figures face with tabular figures, right-aligned, units after in Label size.
Do line facts up in fixed columns with a Label header row.
Do keep the route strip on every page and the copy glyph beside every system name.
Do state defaults and constraints in words above a result list.
Do keep the patterns that work: the Settings row, the Controls side panel, mixed-case row text, ship cartoons, the onboarding step list and primary button, plain-word status and errors.
donts: Don't fill read-only tiles, specs, materials, chips or cards with the brown or grey cell colours.
Don't use orange for headings, values, numbers, dropdown text, chips, badges or decoration, and don't draw the active top tab in white while deeper tabs are orange.
Don't stack more than two tab rows, or put a band between them.
Don't use Share Tech Mono for names, dates, numbers or prose.
Don't add a caps line to a card or row for status or category; Engineers' three caps lines per card become one name, mixed-case facts and brightness.
Don't make the ranked value the smallest text in a row, or put a loud action far from the thing it acts on.
Don't draw a warning or error as a solid orange block; use the "!" and words.
Don't draw an off toggle brighter than an on toggle.
Don't use another hue, a gradient, a shadow, a glow, a radius or an animation.
Don't put an eyebrow label above a title, or a coloured side border on a card.
Don't use Frontier art, fonts, icons or screenshots, or any language but English.
